text_block_list.text:
"I truly appreciate
being given some time off~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: "Mending clothes for my dolls and such allowed me to have a very relaxing time~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's switch gears
and zoom right along~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Making the most of her day off,
Mejiro Bright seems to have gotten plenty of rest.
